title: The side hustle that replaced my 9 to 5 in 30 days

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: I turned my side hustle into my full-time income in 30 days — here's how.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: With remote work booming, having multiple income streams is no longer a luxury.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It’s app-based freelancing using a platform called Upwork, targeting high-paying clients.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The key was specializing in AI content creation, which now pays $50 an hour on average.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This affects freelancers, remote workers, and anyone tired of the 9-to-5 grind.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The takeaway? Skills in AI tools can replace traditional jobs faster than you think.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Ready to turn your skills into a full-time income? Let me know in the comments.
